question: The first winter games in Paralympics history played in Sweden happened in the year ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1976**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first Winter Paralympic Games were held in **Örnsköldsvik, Sweden**, in the year **1976**.
 
• The event featured athletes with physical disabilities competing in **two disciplines: Alpine skiing and Cross-country skiing**.
 
• These games marked the beginning of **Winter Paralympic sports**, expanding the Paralympic movement beyond summer competitions.
 
• A total of **16 nations** participated in the 1976 Winter Paralympics.
 
• The event was originally known as the **1st Paralympic Winter Games**, later officially recognized as part of the Paralympic Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Paralympic Games** were first held in Rome in 1960, exclusively featuring summer sports.
 
• In the Winter Paralympics, **Alpine skiing** includes events such as slalom, giant slalom, and downhill skiing for athletes with disabilities.
 
• Cross-country skiing in the Paralympics involves athletes using specialized equipment such as sit-skis for mobility-impaired participants.
 
• The Paralympics are governed by the **International Paralympic Committee (IPC)**, which oversees rules, classifications, and event standards.
 
• The Winter Paralympics have grown significantly over time, now featuring sports like **para ice hockey and wheelchair curling** in addition to skiing events.
